$comment: Stage target for bun run release:run (D61 rule 2): the same steps as prod.json, against the stage target that scripts/release/stage-target.ts up builds before the run: a copy of production as it runs v0.6.0 (D63), the v0.6.0 stack booted by bun smoke from legacy.checkout against a restored production dump (116-name ledger, identity set to rehearsal). No release commit here: the go file's commit: line names it. HOME is a dedicated directory whose .env names that database. watchMinAttendance is 0.4 on stage: the four external members file against production, never against the stage database, so a stage session holds at most the three in-house takes of seven active members (3/7 = 0.43). Production keeps the gate's default 0.5 (owner-visible, 2026-10-08). watchHours 0.25 and watchSessions deferred: the owner decided on 2026-10-08 that the stage watch is a 15-minute check. W1 runs prod:gate with --sessions deferred and R7.4a skips the in-flight publish check, because no 24 h epoch closes in 15 minutes. Stage epochs are production's (24 h since 2026-10-09). Production keeps the 37 h graded watch, so production's W1 is the first full session proof.
